mechanism: Adalimumab (TNF-alpha inhibitor) may increase infection risk and impair wound healing, while adapalene (retinoid) causes skin irritation and photosensitivity, potentially compounding dermatological adverse effects and immunosuppression.
action: Monitor for signs of infection and excessive skin irritation; ensure adequate sun protection and consider timing of retinoid initiation until adalimumab therapy is well-established; counsel on infection warning signs.
